name: Kim Min-chul
bio: Kim Min Chul is a South Korean actor under Blossom Entertainment. He was born on September 7, 2000, and made his acting debut in 2018. Since then, he has appeared in both film and television dramas, including “Melting Me Softly” (2019) and “Single & Ready to Mingle” (2020).
